name: etsy-signal
description: Etsy Signal — a Chrome extension that analyzes publicly observable Etsy listing data and produces clearly-labelled, explainable sales/revenue estimates.

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w signal-engine && npm run build -w estimation-engine && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w extension
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w estimation-engine && npm run test -w signal-engine && npm run test -w backend
